name: El Rubio (Spain)
description: Red field with stripes of yellow and white along the upper and lower edges, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Rubio (a cross of Saint James and a chequy bend on white and red).
history: Municipal flag of El Rubio; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: El Rubio arms — cross of Saint James on white and chequy bend on red
